output.review_comment: The long deuce advantage logic (inverted when max(p1, p2) > 5) appears to be test-specific code fitting rather than properly justified implementation. The PR explicitly states this logic was added "to ensure the test `test_advantage_after_long_deuce` passes" without explaining why advantage determination should invert at higher scores. This logic contradicts standard scoring behavior. Before merging, please clarify: (1) Is this inverted advantage logic actually part of the spec agreed with the club's match committee? (2) Why would advantage determination behave differently at high scores? (3) If this is indeed the correct spec, add comments explaining this non-obvious behavior.
